profile.summary: cmcnulty is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in jQuery's core DOM manipulation and legacy browser compatibility. Their contributions focus on optimizing DOM serialization, fixing IE ≤ 8 quirks (particularly with HTML5 elements), and refining regex patterns for performance-critical DOM operations. The developer demonstrates precision in writing minimal, high-impact changes that address edge cases while maintaining backward compatibility. While their work is deeply rooted in jQuery and legacy JavaScript, there is no evidence of modern frontend framework experience.
